title: Wishing Well
html:
Wishing Well

The Wishing Well is at the top of Townston, near the Loremaster. Toss in King's Coins (1 if you're a member, 2 if you're not) and it hands something back. Paid tosses drop two items. The first toss is free and drops one. All of it is non-member, not soulbound, and at your current level.

Ninja and Pirate items are only available from the Wishing Well. The ninja look is unique (purple). The pirate rainbows, the mouse-ear helms, and the other Well-only rainbow names are on Well-Only Rainbows. Named boss lair rainbows can also come out of the Well once you are high enough for that dungeon.

The Well is ready every 30 minutes. If it is up it has an ! like a quest giver. If it is not, it has nothing.

Contents

  • 1 Odds
  • 2 Well-specific pile
  • 3 First toss

Odds

The Well does not use dungeon loot percent. These 1-in-N numbers are the same kind of roll as the boss tables on Rainbow Drops. A paid toss is two of those rolls.

WhatPer item
Yellow (rare), the fallbackalways in the mix
Purple from the shared pile1 in 3
Well-specific pile1 in 20
Shared rainbow pile1 in 125
Seasonal purple, when that pack is on1 in 10
Seasonal rainbow, when that pack is on1 in 200

Two items on a paid toss means two shots. About 1 in 10 to see the Well-specific pile at least once. About 1 in 63 to see a shared-pile rainbow at least once.

Well-specific pile

1 in 20 is the pile, not a single name. That pile holds the pirate set, the mouse-ear helms, Charge!, NC Hammer, named lair pieces, skill books, and a gold brick. Armor is the common branch. After that it splits again. A given name is a lot rarer than 1 in 20.

The Well-only names are on Well-Only Rainbows. Named lair pieces are on Boss Lair Rainbows.

First toss

One item. The Well-specific pile on that toss is 1 in 10. The shared rainbow roll is the ordinary boss table: 1 in 200 below 90, 1 in 75 at 90. Gold can also hit.
